triples.evidence_text: the engine room bilge alarm sounded in the wheelhouse; the skipper then went on deck and told one of the deckhands1 to go the engine room and investigate the alarm. When the deckhand arrived in the engine room, he saw a significant amount of water in the bilges.

triples.tail_surface: part opened the sea suction to prime the system
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 微开海水吸入阀进行引水
triples.evidence_text: Knowing that the starboard general service pump was already set up to draw from the engine room bilge, the deckhand part opened the sea suction to prime the system, then started the pump.

triples.tail_surface: rig the vessel’s portable electric submersible pump into the engine room
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在机舱安装便携式电动潜水泵
triples.evidence_text: The skipper then instructed other crew members to rig the vessel’s portable electric submersible pump into the engine room

triples.head_surface: Water welling up under the main engine
triples.tail_surface: took a short video of the flooding on his mobile phone
triples.evidence_text: he saw the water in the bilges and also observed that it was welling up underneath the main engine. ... The skipper also took a short video of the flooding on his mobile phone

triples.head_surface: water discharging from both sea water system hull outlets
triples.head_canonical_zh: 海水系统船体出口排水
triples.tail_surface: looked over the port and starboard sides to check
triples.evidence_text: The skipper then looked over the port and starboard sides to check that water was discharging from both sea water system hull outlets
